missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Часть' is a soft-sign feminine noun in the nominative. 'Важная' is the agreeing feminine adjective and 'самая' forms the superlative.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Часть' is the accusative direct object of 'прочитал'; soft-sign feminines keep the same form in the accusative singular. 'Первую' agrees and 'книги' is genitive.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'не хватает'. 'Части' is the genitive required by 'не хватает'; soft-sign feminines take '-и'. 'Важной' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Части' is the dative form after 'уделил внимание'; soft-sign feminines take '-и'. 'Каждой' agrees and 'он' is the subject.

missions.phrase: Дом построен большей частью из дерева.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental in fixed phrase. 'Частью' is instrumental in the set expression 'большей частью', meaning mostly. The soft-sign feminine takes '-ью' and 'большей' agrees.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'В части' uses the prepositional form 'части' after 'в'. 'Первой' agrees in the feminine prepositional and 'много ошибок' states the quantity.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Часть' is the feminine nominative subject. 'Города' is genitive showing which part, and 'старая' is the agreeing feminine predicate adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after preposition. 'Частей' is the genitive plural required by 'из'. 'Многих' agrees in the genitive plural, and 'машина' is the subject of 'состоит'.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural after preposition. 'Части' is the accusative plural after 'на', expressing division into parts. 'Торт' is the accusative object and 'мы' is the subject.

missions.phrase: Эти части не подходят друг другу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Части' is the nominative plural subject of 'подходят', which agrees in the plural. 'Эти' agrees and 'друг другу' is the dative phrase for one another.
